self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Dryas's Nocturne (R1): at 3 Remedy stacks (gained from Elemental Skill use, Bond of Life increases, or healing), Max HP +40% and Elemental Burst CRIT Rate +28%. Modeled at max stacks. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).
